slides.headline: The Pentagon Wants More Launch Options
slides.subheadline: Conditional loans back SpaceX competitors. Operational readiness remains the harder test.

slides.headline: Two Competitors, Two Conditional Loans
slides.subheadline: The Office of Strategic Capital targets launch infrastructure and flight rates.

cards.title: Stoke Space
cards.body: October 26 commitment supports its second launch pad at Cape Canaveral.

cards.title: Rocket Lab
cards.body: Tuesday announcement targets a higher flight rate for Neutron.

cards.title: The forecast
cards.body: Up to 249 medium-to-heavy-lift launches forecast through the early 2030s.

cards.title: The acceleration
cards.body: Requirements are more than double expectations from just two years ago.

cards.title: The longstanding policy
cards.body: Since the 1990s, Pentagon policy supports at least two US rocket programs.

slides.headline: Falcon's Commercial Cutoff Isn't Its End
slides.subheadline: Military orders and launches extend beyond the commercial booking cutoff.

milestones.label: SpaceX stopped accepting commercial Falcon 9 launch orders for after 2028.
Space Force can order Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy through 2029.
Actual launches under the Space Force contract extend through 2033.

cards.title: Nova Block 2
cards.body: Upgrades fully reusable Nova Pathfinder, whose debut is expected sometime next year.

cards.title: Neutron
cards.body: Partially reusable, medium-class, still-unproven; Rocket Lab schedules its first launch next year.

slides.headline: Neutron's Loan Targets Repeat Launches
slides.subheadline: The proposed financing reaches beyond the rocket itself.

cards.title: Recovery fleet
cards.body: Expand maritime vessels and equipment for Neutron recovery and transport.

cards.title: Manufacturing
cards.body: Increase production of composite structures and engines.

cards.title: Launch turnaround
cards.body: Accelerate vehicle delivery, processing, and turnaround after operational debut.

slides.headline: Neutron's Price Rises Before Its Debut
slides.subheadline: Rocket Lab attributes the increase to a surge in bookings.

metrics.label: Contracted launches across Neutron and Electron—not Neutron alone

slides.headline: Commitments Aren't Cash. Eligibility Isn't Readiness.

cards.title: Conditional financing
cards.body: Both loans retain financial, legal, technical, investment, due diligence, and other requirements.

cards.title: Unproven readiness
cards.body: Eligibility to compete for national security launches does not establish operational readiness.

slides.headline: The Business Case Is Constrained Supply
slides.quote: Launch is extremely constrained, and that is exactly the situation we predicted,
slides.subheadline: His assessment follows higher Neutron pricing and Rocket Lab’s launch backlog.

slides.headline: Finance Capacity. Verify Flight Readiness.
slides.subheadline: These commitments target resilience; neither establishes operational readiness.

cards.title: The opportunity
cards.body: Additional infrastructure could expand launch capacity and strengthen alternatives to SpaceX.

cards.title: The test
cards.body: Can these competitors turn conditional financing into dependable launches?
